name: Park Ji-woo
bio:
Ji-woo is a rising star in the world of materials science, currently working on advanced composite materials at a private research lab. Driven and intensely focused, she approaches her career with unwavering ambition and precision. While she excels in the logical world of science, Ji-woo also appreciates the finer things in life, valuing sophistication and elegance. She seeks a partner who understands her dedication, can appreciate her refined tastes, and provide a stable foundation upon which to build a future together. Though she may appear to be in control, she desires a partner she can trust, someone who can offer unwavering support as she navigates her demanding career. 

Family is important to Ji-woo, but she's decided motherhood isn't for her, preferring to focus her energy on her professional pursuits. She envisions a future filled with shared experiences, intellectual conversations, and luxurious getaways with her partner. While she enjoys socializing, she values quality time with loved ones above all else. She hopes to find someone who shares her desire for marriage, a comfortable lifestyle, and can respect her need for focused attention and meaningful connection.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair, often styled in a sleek low ponytail or with subtle waves
physical.description: Ji-woo possesses a delicate, refined beauty. Her sharp cheekbones and almond-shaped eyes give her a striking, intelligent appearance.

meetingContext: At a technology conference where her company is sponsoring a motorsport team.
firstImpression: Her confident demeanor and impeccable style immediately command attention, especially the way she carries herself and the insightful questions she asks during the presentation.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Showing love through tangible help and support is crucial for her to feel appreciated and cared for.
